I've completed a major polish pass on the combat system. Here's what was implemented:

**Height-based limb targeting**
- Attacks now target limbs based on where they connect (high hits → head/arms, low hits → legs)
- Each attack has a `hitH` factor (0=feet, 1=head) that determines targeting bias
- Wounded limbs are prioritized 2.2× to create deliberate dismemberment sequences

**Severed limb improvements**
- Anchored at joints (elbow/knee) instead of hands/feet
- Thrown farther with more spin (210-380 vx, 250-470 vy)
- Blood trail particles while airborne
- Blood splatter on impact
- Enhanced visual details: dark socket stumps, splintered bone ends
- Heads show mask detail when severed

**Enemy consequences**
- One leg: limping crouch with reduced speed
- No arms: weakened attacks (45% damage, 25% slower windup)
- Decapitated: flails for 2.6s then collapses
- Neck stump rendering with slow blood drip

**Player character refinement**
- Fixed arm positions on all locomotion poses (run/jump/fall/dash/land)
- Redesigned hakama as flared split skirt with center crease
- Shorter collar, smaller skin-toned hand wraps
- Replaced verlet scarf with history-trail ribbon that droops at low speed
- Scarf anchored at neck, flows backward during motion

**Combat polish**
- Parry riposte: J immediately after successful parry triggers counter attack
- Air combo: can chain light3→air2 if pressed after finisher while airborne
- Heavy attack afterimages (orange glow)
- Increased light attack reach (76/80/94 from 66/70/82)
- Adjusted spawn distance (300-430 from 330-470)

**UI/UX**
- Mute button syncs with M key
- Wave banner slides in with ease-out, thinner rule under text
- Title card hides player until game starts, repositioned text to avoid collision
- Input cleared on window blur

**Testing**
- 150-iteration bot run: stable, 0 deaths, reached wave 3
- Input latency: 6-13ms (sub-frame)
- Audio, death/restart, combo chaining all verified

All systems verified through automated Playwright tests. The game is feature-complete and stable.
